hooks.prompt: Before fetching this URL, verify it is the target audit site, a competitor site, or a legitimate SEO tool. Do not fetch unrelated URLs.

After writing audit output, verify: (1) No generic recommendations — every finding references the specific business. (2) Competitor context is included. (3) Every recommendation has specific steps, effort estimate, and expected impact. (4) Priority scoring (Impact x Feasibility) is present. (5) AI visibility angle is considered for content recommendations.

If the user's message triggers an SEO audit (contains 'run an audit', 'seo audit', 'audit this site', etc.), ensure the intake form has been completed with items 1-6 before proceeding. If not collected yet, present the intake form first.
